environment_contract: Caller loads the local realtime bearer SECRET_REDACTED environment variable externally; fixture never loads ~/.env or calls cloud APIs. No token values are written.
execution_contract: Invoke only this pinned fixture with this pinned Python executable and default production config. The captured module code must equal compile(the bounded immutable source snapshot, the captured filename, exec, dont_inherit=True). Canonical code digest is supporting metadata.

fixture.identity_scope: Immutable source snapshot compiled to the attested executed module code; comments and whitespace are not executed.

output_contract: A new O_EXCL 0600 receipt is reserved before configuration or calls; lstat/fstat regular-file, device, inode, nlink=1 and mode checks precede each connection and follow fsync. Custody failure has sanitized stdout only and receipt_published=false.
scope: Exactly two fixed text-to-audio turns, unauthenticated HTTP401 rejection, mandatory correlated IDs on all accepted audio/transcript events, exact transcripts, nonempty even PCM and completed terminal; no listening, acoustic, microphone, interruption or soak qualification.
